text:
Alex: Hey team, found a config that apparently graduated from a poetry class and learned semver.
Alex: ```yaml
# apparently expressive versioning
version: "1.0."  # trailing dot of mysterious origin
metadata:
  author: ops-elf
```
Priya: hahaha the trailing dot is me when I forget to finish a sentence :joy:
Marco: This is the YAML equivalent of saying 'it's fine, trust me' and walking away
Dana: We should add a pre-commit that replaces trailing dots with existential dread :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
CI-bot: ⚠️ deploy blocked — invalid semver: "1.0." detected. See https://semver.org/
Alex: CI-bot saving the world again :raised_hands:
Marco: new lint rule name: 'no-ambiguous-sentences-or-versions'
Priya: poll: react :thumbsup: to auto-fix to 1.0.0, react :thumbsdown: to make it a mystery forever
Dana: also can we get a compiler dad-joke sticker for the dev kitchen? 'Why did the compiler break up with the source? Too many unresolved issues.' :laughing:
Alex: yes to stickers. and to the lint. thanks folks — closing the mystery.
